name: @aise/provider-registry
description: AISE provider evaluation control plane (HFX-000): the machine-readable ProviderProfile schema, the append-only provider registry with its promotion state machine and license/use gate, the normalized provider I/O boundary, the closed failure vocabulary, the benchmark result schema and the portable provenance manifest. Pure deterministic computation over declared inputs — no network, no clock reads, no randomness. Provider-specific types never cross the canonical AISE domain boundary.
